instruction: Choose a suitable engineering drawing/CAD application available in the current Ubuntu environment. The task is to edit a DXF drawing, so select software that can reliably open, modify, and export DXF files. Open or import /home/user/Desktop/guih16_fire_evacuation_seed.dxf. Complete the hard fire evacuation plan and delete all GUIDE entities before saving. Draw WALL segments (0,0)-(8000,0), (8000,0)-(8000,5000), (8000,5000)-(0,5000), (0,5000)-(0,0), (2600,0)-(2600,2100), (2600,3000)-(2600,5000), (5200,0)-(5200,5000), and (0,2500)-(8000,2500). Add DOOR arcs radius 800 at centers (2600,2100), (5200,2500), and (7600,0). Insert EXTINGUISHER blocks at (1200,1200), (4200,3700), and (7000,1600). Draw EXIT arrows (1200,1200)-(300,300), (4200,3700)-(3900,4900), and (7000,1600)-(7800,300). Add EXIT labels, FIRE EVAC PLAN title, and LEGEND: F = EXTINGUISHER. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih16_fire_evacuation_completed.dxf. Complete the work through an interactive graphical workflow and save/export the required DXF file to the exact Desktop path stated above. Do not generate the drawing with external scripts, command-line CAD generation, or by directly writing DXF entities programmatically.
